valueRangeSemantics.sourceEvidence: Pinned builder notebook copies *_from and *_to columns for range variables; other coded variables use value_from plus null value_to.
valueRangeSemantics.runtimeInterpretation: Do not treat the two values as temporal start/end values; year_from/year_to carry the time interval.
valueRangeSemantics.limitation: Workbook has no per-variable definition or confidence-level field. Neither probability/confidence interval nor shared unit can be inferred globally.
valueRangeSemantics.crisisException: CrisisDB has explicit outcome columns and no value_from/value_to columns.
